name: jira-activity-analyzer
description: Static Electron desktop UI prototype for Jira Activity Analyzer.
author: COPGEN

scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/main.cjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run electron:build
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_UI_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_UI_CAPTURE=0 electron dist-electron/main.cjs
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/test-stability.cjs && node scripts/test-round-stability.cjs && node scripts/test-benchmark.cjs && node scripts/test-analysis-defaults.cjs && node scripts/test-source-archive.cjs && node scripts/test-jira-get-retry.cjs && node scripts/test-full-fetch-staging.cjs && node scripts/test-full-fetch-result.cjs && node scripts/test-debug-bundle-sanitizer.cjs
scripts.capture:ui: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_UI_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_UI_CAPTURE=1 electron dist-electron/main.cjs
